notes: Light-shining-through-wall experiment at European XFEL using Laue-case Primakoff conversion in Ge crystals. Table I gives 90% CL upper bounds on g_agamma at 5 detuning angles. The on-Bragg (dtheta=0) bound of 3.91e-4 GeV^-1 covers the broad range 1e-3 eV <= m_a <= 44 eV (below the crystal plasma frequency), encoded as the first two rows. The remaining rows are narrow (width ~1e-3 eV) off-Bragg bounds at discrete masses 340, 460, 1100, 2400 eV. Not a dark-matter search, so no local DM density assumption.
